title: Getting Started with Web Development
author: Hasmita
summary: A friendly introduction to HTML, CSS, and JavaScript for beginners.
content:
Web development is a rewarding journey. In this post, we will cover the basics: how the web works, HTML for structure, CSS for style, and JavaScript for interactivity.

Start small. Build a simple page, style it with CSS, and add small scripts. Practice by recreating UI components you like. Over time, patterns and best practices will become second nature.

Resources: MDN Web Docs, CSS Tricks, and freeCodeCamp are fantastic places to continue learning.

title: Responsive Design Tips You Can Use Today
author: Hasmita
summary: Make your sites look great on any device using flexbox and grid.
content:
Responsive design ensures your site looks great across phones, tablets, and desktops. Use fluid layouts, relative units, and media queries to adapt.

Start with a mobile-first approach: define base styles for small screens, then enhance for larger screens using min-width breakpoints.

Use tools like CSS Grid for page layout and Flexbox for components. Test across multiple devices and emulate different viewports in your browser.

title: Productivity for Developers: Small Habits, Big Results
author: Hasmita
summary: Simple routines to stay focused and ship consistently.
content:
Productivity is less about intensity and more about consistency. Set clear goals, reduce context switching, and create a distraction-free environment.

Adopt time blocks for deep work, keep a short daily plan, and track progress weekly. Automate repetitive tasks and use keyboard shortcuts to save time.

Remember to rest. Breaks help you think better and prevent burnout.

title: A Practical Guide to CSS Grid Layout
author: Hasmita
summary: Learn how to build responsive layouts quickly with CSS Grid.
content:
CSS Grid is a two‑dimensional system that makes complex layouts straightforward. Define containers with display: grid, set columns/rows with grid-template, and place items using grid lines.

Start with simple 2‑column layouts and practice auto‑fit/auto‑fill for responsive grids.

title: Mastering Async/Await in JavaScript
author: Hasmita
summary: Write cleaner asynchronous code with async/await and proper error handling.
content:
Async/await is syntactic sugar over Promises. Mark functions as async and use await to pause until a Promise settles.

Always wrap awaits in try/catch or handle rejections to avoid unhandled errors.

title: Favorite Bootstrap Utilities for Faster UI
author: Hasmita
summary: Spacing, display, and flex utilities that speed up prototyping.
content: Bootstrap's utility classes let you build layouts without custom CSS. Learn spacing (m-*, p-*), display (d-*), and flex (flex-*) utilities to move faster.

title: A Quick Accessibility Checklist for Your Next Project
author: Hasmita
summary: Simple steps to make your site usable for everyone.
content: Ensure sufficient color contrast, keyboard navigability, focus states, alt text for images, and semantic HTML. Test with screen readers and use automated tools like Lighthouse for quick checks.
